sop_thesis: **Payoneer Global (PAYO)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Business Services) with an established market capitalization of $2.41B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty.
